data.body: AC amendment (gap finding 3): Probe ID cross-file consistency. The probe IDs (criticality, non_happy_path, flow_entry_exit) live in prompts/ux-probe-set.md which is NOT in SKILL_CORPUS. Add assertion: read the probe IDs from prompts/ux-probe-set.md directly and assert each ID also appears in SKILL.md gate text (prevents drift if a probe is renamed). Pattern: for id in criticality non_happy_path flow_entry_exit; do grep -q "$id" plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md || fail "SKILL.md gate missing probe ID: $id"; done
